title: Lottie
summary: Small accents drawn in lines of light, generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs: every stroke has a white core, a red echo that trails it, a blue echo that leads it and a lilac glow, screen-blended on near-black. A red dot fires the first line; results land in a blue flash. Slow eased draw-ons, hard lock, no bounce.

items.name: Red dot fire
items.description: The theme's opening move: a red dot blooms and fires a red line to a target; a ring opens where it lands and flashes blue, then the line retracts.

items.name: Arrow
items.description: A red dot fires a line of light to the right; the arrowhead draws in and the tip lands blue.

items.name: Underline
items.description: A red dot fires a rule of light under a line of text, ending in a tick and a blue flash.

items.name: Check
items.description: A ring opens from the top round a check that draws on, landing in a blue flash.

items.name: Ring open
items.description: Two rings of light open from opposite points with ticks round them; a blue flash fills the centre. Emphasis.

items.name: Burst
items.description: A red spark opens into a ring and twelve rays of light shoot out and retract over a blue flash.

items.name: Sparkline
items.description: A rising line of light drawn behind a red head; the last point opens a ring and flashes blue.

items.name: Pulse ring
items.description: Rings of light expanding off a beating red dot. Loops.

items.name: Spinner ring
items.description: A loading arc of light with a red head turning round a dim track. Loops.

items.name: Wave
items.description: A sine wave of light drawing across and retracting over a dim baseline. Loops.

items.name: Typing dots
items.description: Three rings of light swelling in turn: someone is typing. Loops.

items.name: Stars
items.description: Four-point stars drawn in light twinkling and turning slowly. Loops.
